description: In this article, I'll take another look at EVPN Route Controller, since additional features were added in VCF 9.1.1. Direct prefix routing and active/active mode are among the new features that have been introduced.

description: Fun with certificates - we've all been there, right? In this - perhaps brief - blog post, I'll explain how to automate the whole process and use Let's Encrypt. Since this post contains a lot of code, I've decided to publish it all in my public GitHub repo.
title: VCF 9.1 - C.E.R.B.E.R.U.S.: A Let's Encrypt Automation Pipeline

description: In this short blog post, I'd like to briefly describe how to build an offline repository for VCF 9.1 or earlier, from start to finish.
